title: Perfume hero turntable
prompt_en: 16:9 product shot. A glass perfume bottle rotates slowly on a black reflective turntable. A thin rim light outlines the bottle, soft mist drifts behind it, small light glints travel across the glass. Luxury, minimal, dark background.
prompt_zh: 16:9 产品镜头。玻璃香水瓶在黑色反光转台上缓慢旋转。细轮廓光勾勒瓶身，后方飘着薄雾，光点在玻璃上流动。奢华、极简、深色背景。
why_it_works: Turntable rotation is a simple, predictable motion; rim light and mist add premium cues without new objects.
result_check: Bottle shape stays constant during rotation
Label area does not melt or morph
